item.title: Lindsay Clancy's prosecutors question final witnesses about her mental health

item.description: The U.S. threatened secondary sanctions on any nation that trades with Tehran amid a campaign of economic warfare against Iran. Phil Luck, former deputy chief economist at the State Department during the Biden administration, joins with more insight.

item.title: Misty Copeland talks about her new book and why she loves retirement

item.title: Nayeema Raza on why she started her podcast, "Smart Girl Dumb Questions"
item.description: Nayeema Raza, who hosts the podcast "Smart Girl Dumb Questions," joins "CBS Mornings" to talk about the inspiration behind the show and share some of her favorite "dumb" questions. Plus, she helps Gayle, Nate and Vlad figure out who's the best flirt.

item.title: U.S. airman faces charges for criticizing Trump over Iran war
item.description: The charges against Major Jason Watson are believed by his attorneys to be among the only instances for officers of his rank in the history of the U.S. military to be charged under Article 88.

item.title: Canadian finance minister announces retaliatory tariffs against U.S.
